title: ffmpeg
idiom: technical ink diagram / letterpress woodcut — mechanical, precise, hand-inked
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop in the style of a hand-inked technical diagram — letterpress woodcut aesthetic, deep indigo and ink-black ground. A central junction node sits at the meeting point of five converging pipelines drawn as heavy inked conduits, each carrying a different medium (sound wave, film strip, still frame, text, waveform) flowing inward and merging into one unified stream exiting right. The pipes are rendered as precise mechanical cross-sections with hand-hatched shading, bolted flanges, and pressure gauges — industrial plumbing as drafting illustration. One figure (gender-neutral technician) reads a paper readout at the junction; a second figure (different build) adjusts a valve. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem on near-black ground — a single heavy inked pipe junction cross-section viewed head-on, four thick conduits meeting at a center node, rendered as a letterpress woodcut mark with crisp white lines on black. No fine linework — thick strokes only, surviving at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
